attributes.access_name: Cannon River, Miesville Ravine Co Park Public Water Access Site
attributes.directions: Take Hwy 20 north out of Cannon Falls for 1.8 miles to Hwy 17.  Take Hwy 17 east for 4.5 miles to the access.
attributes.alerts: Closed for park construction project all of 2026. There is no access to the river shoreline from the park during construction. Updates can be found at www.dakotacountymn.us, search Miesville site improvement.
